items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: My mother was Dominica Leto, L-E-T-O.

ctx.x: Okay, 26. Okay, your father's name was?

Well, his name was actually Giovanni Cosimo. Cosimo. That's my, his middle name was my first name. Okay. And my grandfather was named Cosimo because that's the way that works sometimes. Firstborns are named after their grandfathers a lot of times. Anyway, he was John C. John Cosimo Matassa. He was born in Sheffaloo, Italy in 1895. Came to the United States in 1910. My mother was Dominica Leto, L-E-T-O. She was born in Palermo, Italy in 1902. Came to the United States in 1904 or 5. My father originally went to a…
